svg.aria-label: Magnesium, page 1 of 3. Drug Magnesium. Also listed as Magnesium ion; Mg2+. Electrolyte replacement / membrane stabilizer. Mode of action Acts as an essential cofactor for numerous enzymatic reactions and blocks neuromuscular transmission by decreasing acetylcholine release. It regulates sodium, potassium, and calcium movement across cell membranes and controls cardiac excitability. Dosage and size available FORMS / STRENGTHS Intravenous/Intramuscular injection: 50 mg/mL (5%), 125 mg/mL (12.5%), 250 mg/mL (25%), 500 mg/mL (50%). Oral tablets/capsules vary by supplement. DOSE / SCOPE Reviewed label, adult mild deficiency: 1 g IM every 6 hours for four doses. This is a product-label example, not a universal regimen. Adjust to labs, kidney function and route; eclampsia and arrhythmia regimens differ.
